name: Angelic Aqua
original_name: アンジェリク・アクア
source:
Aqua's resolute and cool demeanor has earned her the admiration of everyone, and she is seen as a hero. She possesses the mental fortitude to withstand anything, yet she is surprisingly weak to pleasure and is easily swept up by the moment's atmosphere.

She's not aware of it herself, but she gets excited by being exposed to the eyes of an audience.

Her weapon is a magic wand. She fights physically, attacking directly with the wand. She's only good at restraining magic... perhaps a reflection of her subconscious desires.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1343453]Getchu[/url]]
